title: nixpkgs has a due-process problem
excerpt: Three cases where Nixpkgs exercised power without clear rules: a commit-bit removal, a pull request closed by headcount, and a review blocked indefinitely.
content_html:
Nixpkgs has a due-process problem.

A project has a due-process problem when people have real power but the rules around it are vague. Nixpkgs committers can merge and close pull requests. Reviewers can block them. Teams can remove commit access and decide policy. Yet the project does not always say what standard applies, who decides, or how a mistake can be corrected.

This is not an argument against strict review. Security, licensing, attribution, maintainer time, and contributor conduct all matter. The glibc work I recently submitted changes the dynamic loader and rebuilds the world. It should be reviewed unusually carefully. I have also made bad merges.

The test of governance is not whether it gives me what I want. It is whether I would accept the same rules if the people and positions were reversed.

Losing the commit bit

I contributed to Nix and NixOS for more than a decade, served as a release manager, and helped give Nixpkgs commit access to hundreds of contributors. On June 8, 2025, the commit-bit delegation removed my access for a “consistent pattern of bad judgement.” It gave two reasons: I had merged some of my own pull requests soon after opening them, and I had merged an rbtools update that failed to build on every platform.

Both concerns were real. The package was already broken at runtime and I was trying to revive an old leaf package, but I should have checked that the update built. Other contributors later fixed its missing dependencies.

I also should not have merged my pull requests so quickly. A warning thread identified three earlier rapid self-merges and a 37-second self-merged revert. I explained the urgency of the change that prompted the warning, then followed the requested workflow. Another contributor noted that this had been my first formal warning and that I had not self-merged again.

The question is not whether I made mistakes. It is how those mistakes led to an indefinite loss of access, with no defined review or restoration process.

A month earlier, the organization had changed the process. On May 11 it added to the delegation the person who had challenged my merging practice. On May 14 it replaced unanimous agreement on committer-list changes with a rule allowing one delegator to remove a committer. Less than a month later, the new delegator announced my removal.

This sequence does not prove that the rule targeted me or that one person made the decision. The announcement says the team discussed it. What the public record does show is that one-person removal was formally possible, there was no published warning threshold, and the delegation did not contact me first. There was no documented appeal.

The process has since improved. In December 2025, the Nixpkgs core team took over the delegation and published guidelines saying it would try to discuss concerns, give a warning, reach consensus, and identify the participants in a non-unanimous removal.

But these are guidelines the team aspires to follow. The formal rule still says that one member may remove a committer. There is no binding threshold beyond one member, no recusal rule, no response period, and no appeal.

I repeatedly asked the NixOS Steering Committee to review my removal and received no reply. On September 10, 2025, in an email titled “your commit bit,” the person who announced it apologized and said they believed it had been a mistake and that my access should be restored. Readers cannot independently verify this private exchange. I include it because it exposed the practical gap: even when a member of the delegation later considered the removal mistaken, there was no defined review or restoration process. As of this writing, I still do not have Nixpkgs commit access.

A security-sensitive project must be able to suspend access quickly. But an emergency suspension and an indefinite removal are different operations. The second should require a written allegation, notice, a chance to respond, recusal for conflicts, agreement by several disinterested people, reasons, and an appeal.

Who decided?

Nix is not a direct democracy. It has an elected Steering Committee responsible for technical and community leadership and for ensuring that clear decision and escalation processes exist. The committee has delegated Nixpkgs governance to the Nixpkgs core team, whose mandate includes building bottom-up consensus and resolving disagreements. The Steering Committee’s mandate says that delegation does not end its responsibility when a delegated team fails to reach a decision.

The relevant policy had already gone through that structure. After discussion within the core team and with the community team, the core team proposed an automation and AI policy, kept it open for public feedback, and merged it in May 2026. The policy does not ban LLM assistance. It requires a responsible human to review the work and disclose non-trivial automation.

Nixpkgs PR #534657 added one line telling coding agents to follow that policy, plus a CLAUDE.md symlink. It did not propose changing the policy itself. Without that pointer, people using coding agents can submit changes without the tools ever seeing CONTRIBUTING.md, producing avoidable violations of the disclosure and human review rules. Reviewers then inherit the cleanup that a two-line repository change could have prevented.

The pull request disclosed its assistance, and several contributors approved it. Then a reviewer used GitHub’s blocking “request changes” mechanism to say:

The only reasonable AGENTS.md file is:

Get the hell out of here.

This named no defect, cited no rule, and offered no path to acceptance. It also fell short of Nixpkgs’s review guidance, which asks reviewers to focus on the change, keep the scope narrow, explain why related work must block it, and drive it to a conclusion.

There were good reasons to question the pull request. Its checklist overstated what had been tested. CLAUDE.md privileged one vendor. An agent file might signal that a project wants more automated contributions. A reviewer could reasonably ask for vendor-neutral wording or evidence that the file improved policy compliance.

Instead, much of the thread became an argument about copyright, energy, water, capitalism, employment, creativity, and whether LLM users belong in free software. A mechanism for making tools read the rules became a vote on the tools themselves.

After internal discussion and testing, the core team stated that a minimal agent file pointing to the policy was likely to benefit the community. A core team member then clarified that this was an opinion, not a final decision, and that a continuing deadlock would ultimately be the core team’s responsibility to resolve.

Nine days later, a committer closed the pull request as “rejected by the community”. The closing comment relied on comments, reactions, and an informal Discourse poll. It called the contribution “slop” and “vibe-checked,” and argued that “some kind of majority decision” was enough to reject it. It offered an appeal to the core team, but no published rule defined that majority, when an appeal applied, or what standard the core team would use. The same comment urged anyone considering an appeal to first ask whether it would “really be in the best interest of the community.” An appeal discouraged by the person whose decision it reviews is not much of a remedy. I did not appeal. I replied on the pull request that the closure conflicted with the automation policy Nixpkgs had adopted and that the thread could not speak for the community.

Nixpkgs aims for bottom-up consensus, but consensus is not a count of whoever shows up in a comment thread. Reactions and a voluntary poll can inform a decision. The poll asked how people felt about LLM usage in general, not whether Nixpkgs should help contributors who already use LLMs work productively while following its policy. Neutrality on the first question does not imply opposition to the second. Nor can the poll represent “the community” without a defined electorate, scope, quorum, threshold, or rule assigning the decision to that vote. The thread produced the appearance of direct democracy without a democratic process.

Perhaps the pull request should have been rejected. The problem is not that its author disagreed. The problem is that no published rule authorized one committer to convert informal feedback into a decision by “the community.” GitHub permissions answered who could close the pull request. They did not answer who had decided the policy question.

When review becomes personal

Nixpkgs PR #535735 is the opposite kind of change. It patches glibc, updates patchelf, touches the bootstrap path, and causes a mass rebuild. Nobody should merge it casually.

The change addresses startup overhead paid by nearly every dynamically linked Linux program in Nixpkgs. For short-lived tools, that overhead can rival the useful work the program performs, and it compounds across shell prompts, scripts, builds, and services that launch many processes. If it works at Nixpkgs scale, the benefit would reach the whole package set rather than devenv alone, with the largest gains on cold or slow storage, network filesystems, and low-power systems.

That reach is also what makes the patch risky: a loader regression could affect almost everything. I spent a full week at Tacosprint comparing five approaches and getting the change working end to end. That effort did not make the patch merge-ready or lower the review bar.

One blocking review was explicitly preemptive. On June 26, the reviewer said they would need to reserve “a bunch of hours” to examine the change and that this would not happen for “the next few weeks,” while using “Request Changes” to prevent an “overexcited committer” from merging it. I asked on July 12 when the review might happen and again on July 25 after a month had passed. As of this writing, no detailed review or deadline had followed, and the block remained. Nixpkgs permits an abandoned review to be dismissed, but does not say when a promised future review becomes abandoned.

The useful reviews were demanding. They found bounds-checking and 32-bit overflow problems, questioned the cache format, asked about future loaders, and challenged whether a downstream glibc patch should be enabled before going upstream. The pull request improved because of them. This is what review is for.

Those technical concerns could independently justify blocking the patch. But some comments moved from the patch to the author. A blocking review questioned what expertise I had acquired and whether I had a hidden goal. The original author of an earlier implementation called LLMs “plagiarism machinery” and asked that the work not be merged.

Attribution was a legitimate concern. I added the original author as a co-author to the Nixpkgs commit and credited the earlier approach elsewhere, but reviewers argued that the patchelf history still lacked durable attribution and that the boundary between the old and new work was unclear. Those are defects that can be fixed.

The work was public, licensed, and abandoned; continuing it did not require the original author’s permission. In hindsight, advance notice might have avoided surprise and made collaboration easier.

The distinction is simple. “This must go upstream first” is a requirement. “The cache needs a compatibility contract” is a requirement. “Credit the old work in these permanent locations” is a requirement. “Answer these loader questions and identify a maintainer” is a requirement.

“We do not know whether the author has expertise” becomes useful only when it points to a specific unanswered question or maintenance risk. “Perhaps he wants something else” is merely a guess about motive.

These three cases differ in severity. In each, legitimate concerns became entangled with an exercise of authority whose basis, limits, or remedy were unclear.

The older problem

AI made this conflict visible, but did not create it.

Jo Freeman’s 1972 essay The Tyranny of Structurelessness described the same failure in the feminist movement. A group that refuses formal structure does not get rid of power. It hides power in informal elites and unwritten criteria that newcomers cannot see or appeal to. Freeman’s fix was explicit delegation, defined authority, and accountability to the group.

Other open-source projects put explicit constraints around power. The Apache Software Foundation says that a veto without technical justification is invalid. Python’s conduct-enforcement procedure requires conflict checks, a two-thirds vote, a concrete plan, and re-evaluation when the reported person responds. Rust provides independent audits of visible sanctions and requires conflicted auditors to recuse themselves. Debian developers can override delegated decisions, while OpenStack requires notice, discussion, quorum, and a recorded vote for governance motions.

The mechanisms differ. Their purpose is the same: make authority legible and make mistakes correctable.

Pieter Hintjens’s Collective Code Construction Contract goes further. It defines a correct patch through written requirements, tells maintainers not to make value judgments about one, and asks anyone who prefers another correct solution to submit that solution as a competing patch. Hintjens called review delay “change latency.” He warned that delaying and blocking patches gives maintainers power over contributors, even when the abuse is subconscious, and argued that a project whose maintainers cannot respond rapidly needs more hands.

Nixpkgs should not optimistically merge a world-rebuilding glibc patch. But it can adopt the underlying rule: a concrete risk may block; an unavailable reviewer or an undocumented preference may not. Risky experiments need an isolated test path, not an indefinite veto.

Review friction has a real cost, though the evidence should not be overstated. I am not aware of a controlled study showing that nitpicking is the main reason people leave Nixpkgs. There are, however, repeated reports of contributors losing interest when requirements are undocumented or inconsistent.

A 2021 contributor said conflicting formatter requests made them want to close their pull requests and spend their time elsewhere. A 2023 thread collected similar reports about obstacles to contribution. The 2022 community survey found that some respondents avoided opening pull requests because the backlog made timely review seem unlikely. In the 2025 survey, 7.0% reported slow feedback, 5.8% got stuck after starting, and 2.1% found feedback unhelpful or unclear. These categories overlap, and the survey does not attribute them specifically to nitpicking.

Strict review is not itself a problem. The problem is a preference presented as a requirement without a rule, a concrete risk, or a stable condition for acceptance. If a mechanical rule matters enough to block a contribution, write it down and automate it. If it is merely a preference, call it a suggestion.

What should change

Nixpkgs does not need ideological agreement. It needs rules strong enough for people who disagree to keep working together.

First, separate emergency suspension from indefinite removal. An indefinite removal should require written allegations against published standards, notice, time to respond, conflict checks, and agreement by a panel of at least three disinterested people. It should end with a reasoned summary and an appeal to an independent body. The newer guidelines are a good start; they should replace the formal one-person rule.

Second, make blocking reviews actionable. Nixpkgs already says that comments are non-blocking by default, that blocks must use “Request Changes,” and that abandoned reviews may be dismissed. A block should also identify a documented requirement, policy violation, or technical risk, and say how it can be resolved.

Review feedback then falls into three categories. A required change names a defect and a stable acceptance condition. A suggestion offers a preferred alternative to an otherwise acceptable patch. A follow-up expands the scope and belongs in a separate issue. Only the first should block.

Third, define how project-wide policy is decided. Name the decision-maker, who may participate, the discussion period, the threshold, whether polls are advisory, where reasons and dissent are recorded, and when the decision may be revisited. GitHub reactions are feedback, not a constitution.

Fourth, apply the automation policy Nixpkgs actually adopted. Hold the human responsible, require disclosure, and reject unreviewed or poor work. Then judge compliant contributions against the stated technical rules. If Nixpkgs wants to ban LLM assistance, it should change the policy explicitly.

Fifth, test claims where possible. A vendor-neutral AGENTS.md proposal could include a before-and-after test: does it improve disclosure, checklist accuracy, test execution, and policy compliance? The policy itself could be reviewed using data about reverts, CI failures, review time, violations, and maintainer burden.

Finally, automate mechanical requirements. Formatting, metadata, and platform checks should be reproducible commands or branch protections, not different rules carried in different reviewers’ heads.

These reforms should be separate decisions. My request for restored access should not decide the general removal process. A two-line agent file should not decide the whole automation policy. A risky glibc patch should not decide whether LLM-assisted contributors belong.

The same rules should protect an anti-AI contributor under a future pro-AI majority. Otherwise due process is only a request to replace one faction’s discretion with another’s.

Write clear rules. Require actionable review. Give notice, reasons, recusal, and appeal. Judge work under the policy that exists until that policy is changed through a legitimate process.

Due process requires clear rules for removals, review blocks, and policy decisions. It also requires a way to correct mistakes.

The glibc work I recently submitted changes the dynamic loader and rebuilds the world. It should be reviewed unusually carefully. I have also made bad merges.

sentences.en: This is not an argument against strict review.
sentences.zh: 这并不是反对严格审查的理由。

sentences.en: Security, licensing, attribution, maintainer time, and contributor conduct all matter.
sentences.zh: 安全性、许可、归属、维护者时间和贡献者行为都很重要。

sentences.en: The glibc work I recently submitted changes the dynamic loader and rebuilds the world.
sentences.zh: 我最近提交的glibc工作改变了动态加载器并重建了世界。

sentences.en: It should be reviewed unusually carefully.
sentences.zh: 应异常仔细地对其进行审查。

sentences.en: I have also made bad merges.
sentences.zh: 我也做过糟糕的合并。

blocks.html_en: The test of governance is not whether it gives me what I want. It is whether I would accept the same rules if the people and positions were reversed.

sentences.en: The test of governance is not whether it gives me what I want.
sentences.zh: 对治理的考验不是它是否给了我我想要的东西。

sentences.en: It is whether I would accept the same rules if the people and positions were reversed.
sentences.zh: 问题是如果人和职位对调我是否会接受同样的规则。

blocks.html_en: Losing the commit bit

sentences.en: Losing the commit bit
sentences.zh: 丢失提交位

blocks.html_en: I contributed to Nix and NixOS for more than a decade, served as a release manager, and helped give Nixpkgs commit access to hundreds of contributors. On June 8, 2025, the commit-bit delegation removed my access for a “consistent pattern of bad judgement.” It gave two reasons: I had merged some of my own pull requests soon after opening them, and I had merged an rbtools update that failed to build on every platform.

sentences.en: I contributed to Nix and NixOS for more than a decade, served as a release manager, and helped give Nixpkgs commit access to hundreds of contributors.
sentences.zh: 我为 Nix 和 NixOS 做出了十多年的贡献，担任发布经理，并帮助 Nixpkgs 向数百名贡献者授予了提交访问权限。

sentences.en: On June 8, 2025, the commit-bit delegation removed my access for a “consistent pattern of bad judgement.”
sentences.zh: 2025 年 6 月 8 日，提交位代表团以“一贯的错误判断模式”为由删除了我的访问权限。

sentences.en: It gave two reasons: I had merged some of my own pull requests soon after opening them, and I had merged an rbtools update that failed to build on every platform.
sentences.zh: 它给出了两个原因：我在打开拉取请求后不久就合并了它们，并且我合并了无法在每个平台上构建的 rbtools 更新。

blocks.html_en: Both concerns were real. The package was already broken at runtime and I was trying to revive an old leaf package, but I should have checked that the update built. Other contributors later fixed its missing dependencies.

sentences.en: Both concerns were real.
sentences.zh: 这两种担忧都是真实的。

sentences.en: The package was already broken at runtime and I was trying to revive an old leaf package, but I should have checked that the update built.
sentences.zh: 该包在运行时已经损坏，我试图恢复旧的叶包，但我应该检查更新是否已构建。

sentences.en: Other contributors later fixed its missing dependencies.
sentences.zh: 其他贡献者后来修复了其缺失的依赖项。

blocks.html_en: I also should not have merged my pull requests so quickly. A warning thread identified three earlier rapid self-merges and a 37-second self-merged revert. I explained the urgency of the change that prompted the warning, then followed the requested workflow. Another contributor noted that this had been my first formal warning and that I had not self-merged again.

sentences.en: I also should not have merged my pull requests so quickly.
sentences.zh: 我也不应该这么快合并我的拉取请求。

sentences.en: A warning thread identified three earlier rapid self-merges and a 37-second self-merged revert.
sentences.zh: 一条警告线程识别出三个较早的快速自合并和一个 37 秒的自合并恢复。

sentences.en: I explained the urgency of the change that prompted the warning, then followed the requested workflow.
sentences.zh: 我解释了引发警告的更改的紧迫性，然后按照要求的工作流程进行操作。

sentences.en: Another contributor noted that this had been my first formal warning and that I had not self-merged again.
sentences.zh: 另一位贡献者指出，这是我第一次正式警告，我没有再次自我合并。

blocks.html_en: The question is not whether I made mistakes. It is how those mistakes led to an indefinite loss of access, with no defined review or restoration process.

sentences.en: The question is not whether I made mistakes.
sentences.zh: 问题不在于我是否犯了错误。

sentences.en: It is how those mistakes led to an indefinite loss of access, with no defined review or restoration process.
sentences.zh: 这就是这些错误导致无限期失去访问权限、且没有明确的审查或恢复流程的原因。

blocks.html_en: A month earlier, the organization had changed the process. On May 11 it added to the delegation the person who had challenged my merging practice. On May 14 it replaced unanimous agreement on committer-list changes with a rule allowing one delegator to remove a committer. Less than a month later, the new delegator announced my removal.

sentences.en: A month earlier, the organization had changed the process.
sentences.zh: 一个月前，该组织改变了流程。

sentences.en: On May 11 it added to the delegation the person who had challenged my merging practice.
sentences.zh: 5 月 11 日，它向代表团添加了对我的合并做法提出质疑的人。

sentences.en: On May 14 it replaced unanimous agreement on committer-list changes with a rule allowing one delegator to remove a committer.
sentences.zh: 5 月 14 日，它用允许一名委托者删除提交者的规则取代了对提交者列表变更的一致同意。

sentences.en: Less than a month later, the new delegator announced my removal.
sentences.zh: 不到一个月后，新的代表宣布我的免职。

blocks.html_en: This sequence does not prove that the rule targeted me or that one person made the decision. The announcement says the team discussed it. What the public record does show is that one-person removal was formally possible, there was no published warning threshold, and the delegation did not contact me first. There was no documented appeal.

sentences.en: This sequence does not prove that the rule targeted me or that one person made the decision.
sentences.zh: 这一序列并不能证明该规则是针对我的，或者是一个人做出的决定。

sentences.en: The announcement says the team discussed it.
sentences.zh: 公告称，团队对此进行了讨论。

sentences.en: What the public record does show is that one-person removal was formally possible, there was no published warning threshold, and the delegation did not contact me first.
sentences.zh: 公开记录确实表明，单人驱逐是正式可能的，没有公布警告阈值，代表团也没有先联系我。

sentences.en: There was no documented appeal.
sentences.zh: 没有任何书面上诉。

blocks.html_en: The process has since improved. In December 2025, the Nixpkgs core team took over the delegation and published guidelines saying it would try to discuss concerns, give a warning, reach consensus, and identify the participants in a non-unanimous removal.

sentences.en: The process has since improved.
sentences.zh: 此后，该流程得到了改进。

sentences.en: In December 2025, the Nixpkgs core team took over the delegation and published guidelines saying it would try to discuss concerns, give a warning, reach consensus, and identify the participants in a non-unanimous removal.
sentences.zh: 2025年12月，Nixpkgs核心团队接管了该代表团，并发布了指导方针，表示将尽力讨论担忧、发出警告、达成共识，并确定非一致罢免的参与者。

blocks.html_en: But these are guidelines the team aspires to follow. The formal rule still says that one member may remove a committer. There is no binding threshold beyond one member, no recusal rule, no response period, and no appeal.

sentences.en: But these are guidelines the team aspires to follow.
sentences.zh: 但这些是团队渴望遵循的指导方针。

sentences.en: The formal rule still says that one member may remove a committer.
sentences.zh: 正式规则仍然规定一名成员可以删除一名提交者。

sentences.en: There is no binding threshold beyond one member, no recusal rule, no response period, and no appeal.
sentences.zh: 没有超过一名成员的约束性门槛，没有回避规则，没有回应期，也没有上诉。

blocks.html_en: I repeatedly asked the NixOS Steering Committee to review my removal and received no reply. On September 10, 2025, in an email titled “your commit bit,” the person who announced it apologized and said they believed it had been a mistake and that my access should be restored. Readers cannot independently verify this private exchange. I include it because it exposed the practical gap: even when a member of the delegation later considered the removal mistaken, there was no defined review or restoration process. As of this writing, I still do not have Nixpkgs commit access.

sentences.en: I repeatedly asked the NixOS Steering Committee to review my removal and received no reply.
sentences.zh: 我多次要求 NixOS 指导委员会审查我的删除行为，但没有收到回复。

sentences.en: On September 10, 2025, in an email titled “your commit bit,” the person who announced it apologized and said they believed it had been a mistake and that my access should be restored.
sentences.zh: 2025 年 9 月 10 日，在一封题为“你的提交位”的电子邮件中，宣布该消息的人道歉，并表示他们认为这是一个错误，我的访问权限应该恢复。

sentences.en: Readers cannot independently verify this private exchange.
sentences.zh: 读者无法独立验证这种私人交换。

sentences.en: I include it because it exposed the practical gap: even when a member of the delegation later considered the removal mistaken, there was no defined review or restoration process.
sentences.zh: 我将其列入是因为它暴露了实际差距：即使代表团成员后来认为删除是错误的，也没有明确的审查或恢复过程。

sentences.en: As of this writing, I still do not have Nixpkgs commit access.
sentences.zh: 截至撰写本文时，我仍然没有 Nixpkgs 提交访问权限。

blocks.html_en: A security-sensitive project must be able to suspend access quickly. But an emergency suspension and an indefinite removal are different operations. The second should require a written allegation, notice, a chance to respond, recusal for conflicts, agreement by several disinterested people, reasons, and an appeal.

sentences.en: A security-sensitive project must be able to suspend access quickly.
sentences.zh: 安全敏感的项目必须能够快速暂停访问。

sentences.en: But an emergency suspension and an indefinite removal are different operations.
sentences.zh: 但紧急暂停和无限期移除是不同的操作。

sentences.en: The second should require a written allegation, notice, a chance to respond, recusal for conflicts, agreement by several disinterested people, reasons, and an appeal.
sentences.zh: 第二个应该要求书面指控、通知、回应机会、冲突回避、几个无利害关系人的同意、理由和上诉。

blocks.html_en: Who decided?

sentences.en: Who decided?
sentences.zh: 谁决定的？

blocks.html_en: Nix is not a direct democracy. It has an elected Steering Committee responsible for technical and community leadership and for ensuring that clear decision and escalation processes exist. The committee has delegated Nixpkgs governance to the Nixpkgs core team, whose mandate includes building bottom-up consensus and resolving disagreements. The Steering Committee’s mandate says that delegation does not end its responsibility when a delegated team fails to reach a decision.

sentences.en: Nix is not a direct democracy.
sentences.zh: 尼克斯不是直接民主国家。

sentences.en: It has an elected Steering Committee responsible for technical and community leadership and for ensuring that clear decision and escalation processes exist.
sentences.zh: 它有一个选举产生的指导委员会，负责技术和社区领导，并确保存在明确的决策和升级流程。

sentences.en: The committee has delegated Nixpkgs governance to the Nixpkgs core team, whose mandate includes building bottom-up consensus and resolving disagreements.
sentences.zh: 该委员会已将 Nixpkgs 的治理委托给 Nixpkgs 核心团队，其任务包括建立自下而上的共识并解决分歧。

sentences.en: The Steering Committee’s mandate says that delegation does not end its responsibility when a delegated team fails to reach a decision.
sentences.zh: 指导委员会的任务规定，当被授权的团队未能达成决定时，授权并不会终止其责任。

blocks.html_en: The relevant policy had already gone through that structure. After discussion within the core team and with the community team, the core team proposed an automation and AI policy, kept it open for public feedback, and merged it in May 2026. The policy does not ban LLM assistance. It requires a responsible human to review the work and disclose non-trivial automation.

sentences.en: The relevant policy had already gone through that structure.
sentences.zh: 相关政策已经经过了这个结构。

sentences.en: After discussion within the core team and with the community team, the core team proposed an automation and AI policy, kept it open for public feedback, and merged it in May 2026.
sentences.zh: 经过核心团队内部以及与社区团队的讨论，核心团队提出了自动化和人工智能政策，开放征求公众反馈，并于 2026 年 5 月合并。

sentences.en: The policy does not ban LLM assistance.
sentences.zh: 该政策并不禁止 LLM 援助。

sentences.en: It requires a responsible human to review the work and disclose non-trivial automation.
sentences.zh: 它需要一个负责任的人来审查工作并披露不平凡的自动化。

blocks.html_en: Nixpkgs PR #534657 added one line telling coding agents to follow that policy, plus a CLAUDE.md symlink. It did not propose changing the policy itself. Without that pointer, people using coding agents can submit changes without the tools ever seeing CONTRIBUTING.md, producing avoidable violations of the disclosure and human review rules. Reviewers then inherit the cleanup that a two-line repository change could have prevented.

sentences.en: Nixpkgs PR #534657 added one line telling coding agents to follow that policy, plus a CLAUDE.md symlink.
sentences.zh: Nixpkgs PR #534657 添加了一行告诉编码代理遵循该策略，以及 CLAUDE.md 符号链接。

sentences.en: It did not propose changing the policy itself.
sentences.zh: 它没有提议改变政策本身。

sentences.en: Without that pointer, people using coding agents can submit changes without the tools ever seeing CONTRIBUTING.md, producing avoidable violations of the disclosure and human review rules.
sentences.zh: 如果没有该指针，使用编码代理的人们可以在工具看到 CONTRIBUTING.md 的情况下提交更改，从而产生可避免的违反披露和人工审核规则的行为。

sentences.en: Reviewers then inherit the cleanup that a two-line repository change could have prevented.
sentences.zh: 然后，审阅者继承了两行存储库更改可能会阻止的清理工作。

blocks.html_en: The pull request disclosed its assistance, and several contributors approved it. Then a reviewer used GitHub’s blocking “request changes” mechanism to say:

sentences.en: The pull request disclosed its assistance, and several contributors approved it.
sentences.zh: 拉取请求披露了其帮助，并且一些贡献者批准了它。

sentences.en: Then a reviewer used GitHub’s blocking “request changes” mechanism to say:
sentences.zh: 然后一位审稿人利用 GitHub 的阻塞“请求更改”机制说道：

blocks.html_en:
The only reasonable AGENTS.md file is:

Get the hell out of here.

sentences.en: The only reasonable AGENTS.md file is: Get the hell out of here.
sentences.zh: 唯一合理的 AGENTS.md 文件是：滚出这里。

blocks.html_en: The only reasonable AGENTS.md file is:

sentences.en: The only reasonable AGENTS.md file is:
sentences.zh: 唯一合理的 AGENTS.md 文件是：

blocks.html_en: Get the hell out of here.

sentences.en: Get the hell out of here.
sentences.zh: 赶紧离开这里吧。

blocks.html_en: This named no defect, cited no rule, and offered no path to acceptance. It also fell short of Nixpkgs’s review guidance, which asks reviewers to focus on the change, keep the scope narrow, explain why related work must block it, and drive it to a conclusion.

sentences.en: This named no defect, cited no rule, and offered no path to acceptance.
sentences.zh: 这没有指出任何缺陷，没有引用任何规则，也没有提供任何接受的途径。

sentences.en: It also fell short of Nixpkgs’s review guidance, which asks reviewers to focus on the change, keep the scope narrow, explain why related work must block it, and drive it to a conclusion.
sentences.zh: 它还没有达到 Nixpkgs 的审查指南，该指南要求审查人员关注变更，缩小范围，解释为什么相关工作必须阻止它，并得出结论。

blocks.html_en: There were good reasons to question the pull request. Its checklist overstated what had been tested. CLAUDE.md privileged one vendor. An agent file might signal that a project wants more automated contributions. A reviewer could reasonably ask for vendor-neutral wording or evidence that the file improved policy compliance.

sentences.en: There were good reasons to question the pull request.
sentences.zh: 有充分的理由质疑拉取请求。

sentences.en: Its checklist overstated what had been tested.
sentences.zh: 它的清单夸大了已经测试过的内容。

sentences.en: CLAUDE.md privileged one vendor.
sentences.zh: CLAUDE.md 对一位供应商给予了特权。

sentences.en: An agent file might signal that a project wants more automated contributions.
sentences.zh: 代理文件可能表明项目需要更多自动化贡献。

sentences.en: A reviewer could reasonably ask for vendor-neutral wording or evidence that the file improved policy compliance.
sentences.zh: 审阅者可以合理地要求提供供应商中立的措辞或证明该文件改进了策略合规性的证据。

blocks.html_en: Instead, much of the thread became an argument about copyright, energy, water, capitalism, employment, creativity, and whether LLM users belong in free software. A mechanism for making tools read the rules became a vote on the tools themselves.

sentences.en: Instead, much of the thread became an argument about copyright, energy, water, capitalism, employment, creativity, and whether LLM users belong in free software.
sentences.zh: 相反，该帖子的大部分内容变成了关于版权、能源、水、资本主义、就业、创造力以及 LLM 用户是否属于自由软件的争论。

sentences.en: A mechanism for making tools read the rules became a vote on the tools themselves.
sentences.zh: 让工具读取规则的机制变成了对工具本身的投票。

blocks.html_en: After internal discussion and testing, the core team stated that a minimal agent file pointing to the policy was likely to benefit the community. A core team member then clarified that this was an opinion, not a final decision, and that a continuing deadlock would ultimately be the core team’s responsibility to resolve.

sentences.en: After internal discussion and testing, the core team stated that a minimal agent file pointing to the policy was likely to benefit the community.
sentences.zh: 经过内部讨论和测试后，核心团队表示，指向该政策的最小代理文件可能会给社区带来好处。

sentences.en: A core team member then clarified that this was an opinion, not a final decision, and that a continuing deadlock would ultimately be the core team’s responsibility to resolve.
sentences.zh: 一位核心团队成员随后澄清，这只是一个意见，而不是最终决定，持续的僵局最终将由核心团队负责解决。

blocks.html_en: Nine days later, a committer closed the pull request as “rejected by the community”. The closing comment relied on comments, reactions, and an informal Discourse poll. It called the contribution “slop” and “vibe-checked,” and argued that “some kind of majority decision” was enough to reject it. It offered an appeal to the core team, but no published rule defined that majority, when an appeal applied, or what standard the core team would use. The same comment urged anyone considering an appeal to first ask whether it would “really be in the best interest of the community.” An appeal discouraged by the person whose decision it reviews is not much of a remedy. I did not appeal. I replied on the pull request that the closure conflicted with the automation policy Nixpkgs had adopted and that the thread could not speak for the community.

sentences.en: Nine days later, a committer closed the pull request as “rejected by the community”.
sentences.zh: 九天后，一名提交者以“被社区拒绝”为由关闭了拉取请求。

sentences.en: The closing comment relied on comments, reactions, and an informal Discourse poll.
sentences.zh: 最后的评论依赖于评论、反应和非正式的 Discourse 民意调查。

sentences.en: It called the contribution “slop” and “vibe-checked,” and argued that “some kind of majority decision” was enough to reject it.
sentences.zh: 它称该贡献“草率”和“氛围检查”，并认为“某种多数决定”足以拒绝它。

sentences.en: It offered an appeal to the core team, but no published rule defined that majority, when an appeal applied, or what standard the core team would use.
sentences.zh: 它向核心团队提出了上诉，但没有公布的规则定义了多数、何时适用上诉或核心团队将使用什么标准。

sentences.en: The same comment urged anyone considering an appeal to first ask whether it would “really be in the best interest of the community.”
sentences.zh: 同一条评论敦促任何考虑上诉的人首先询问这是否“真的符合社区的最大利益”。

sentences.en: An appeal discouraged by the person whose decision it reviews is not much of a remedy.
sentences.zh: 被审查决定的人劝阻的上诉并不是什么补救措施。

sentences.en: I did not appeal.
sentences.zh: 我没有上诉。

sentences.en: I replied on the pull request that the closure conflicted with the automation policy Nixpkgs had adopted and that the thread could not speak for the community.
sentences.zh: 我在拉取请求中回复说，关闭与 Nixpkgs 所采用的自动化政策相冲突，并且该线程无法代表社区发言。

blocks.html_en: Nixpkgs aims for bottom-up consensus, but consensus is not a count of whoever shows up in a comment thread. Reactions and a voluntary poll can inform a decision. The poll asked how people felt about LLM usage in general, not whether Nixpkgs should help contributors who already use LLMs work productively while following its policy. Neutrality on the first question does not imply opposition to the second. Nor can the poll represent “the community” without a defined electorate, scope, quorum, threshold, or rule assigning the decision to that vote. The thread produced the appearance of direct democracy without a democratic process.

sentences.en: Nixpkgs aims for bottom-up consensus, but consensus is not a count of whoever shows up in a comment thread.
sentences.zh: Nixpkgs 的目标是自下而上达成共识，但共识并不是对出现在评论线程中的人进行计数。

sentences.en: Reactions and a voluntary poll can inform a decision.
sentences.zh: 反应和自愿民意调查可以为决定提供依据。

sentences.en: The poll asked how people felt about LLM usage in general, not whether Nixpkgs should help contributors who already use LLMs work productively while following its policy.
sentences.zh: 该民意调查询问人们对 LLM 使用的总体感受，而不是 Nixpkgs 是否应该帮助已经使用 LLM 的贡献者在遵循其政策的同时高效工作。

sentences.en: Neutrality on the first question does not imply opposition to the second.
sentences.zh: 对第一个问题的中立并不意味着反对第二个问题。

sentences.en: Nor can the poll represent “the community” without a defined electorate, scope, quorum, threshold, or rule assigning the decision to that vote.
sentences.zh: 如果没有明确的选民、范围、法定人数、阈值或将决定分配给投票的规则，民意调查也不能代表“社区”。

sentences.en: The thread produced the appearance of direct democracy without a democratic process.
sentences.zh: 这条线索产生了没有民主程序的直接民主的表象。

blocks.html_en: Perhaps the pull request should have been rejected. The problem is not that its author disagreed. The problem is that no published rule authorized one committer to convert informal feedback into a decision by “the community.” GitHub permissions answered who could close the pull request. They did not answer who had decided the policy question.

sentences.en: Perhaps the pull request should have been rejected.
sentences.zh: 也许拉取请求应该被拒绝。

sentences.en: The problem is not that its author disagreed.
sentences.zh: 问题不在于其作者不同意。

sentences.en: The problem is that no published rule authorized one committer to convert informal feedback into a decision by “the community.”
sentences.zh: 问题在于，没有任何已发布的规则授权提交者将非正式反馈转化为“社区”的决定。

sentences.en: GitHub permissions answered who could close the pull request.
sentences.zh: GitHub 权限回答了谁可以关闭拉取请求。

sentences.en: They did not answer who had decided the policy question.
sentences.zh: 他们没有回答谁决定了政策问题。

blocks.html_en: When review becomes personal

sentences.en: When review becomes personal
sentences.zh: 当评论变得个性化时

blocks.html_en: Nixpkgs PR #535735 is the opposite kind of change. It patches glibc, updates patchelf, touches the bootstrap path, and causes a mass rebuild. Nobody should merge it casually.

sentences.en: Nixpkgs PR #535735 is the opposite kind of change.
sentences.zh: Nixpkgs PR #535735 是相反的变化。

sentences.en: It patches glibc, updates patchelf, touches the bootstrap path, and causes a mass rebuild.
sentences.zh: 它修补 glibc、更新 patchelf、触及引导路径并导致大规模重建。

sentences.en: Nobody should merge it casually.
sentences.zh: 任何人都不能随意合并。

blocks.html_en: The change addresses startup overhead paid by nearly every dynamically linked Linux program in Nixpkgs. For short-lived tools, that overhead can rival the useful work the program performs, and it compounds across shell prompts, scripts, builds, and services that launch many processes. If it works at Nixpkgs scale, the benefit would reach the whole package set rather than devenv alone, with the largest gains on cold or slow storage, network filesystems, and low-power systems.

sentences.en: The change addresses startup overhead paid by nearly every dynamically linked Linux program in Nixpkgs.
sentences.zh: 这一更改解决了 Nixpkgs 中几乎每个动态链接的 Linux 程序所产生的启动开销。

sentences.en: For short-lived tools, that overhead can rival the useful work the program performs, and it compounds across shell prompts, scripts, builds, and services that launch many processes.
sentences.zh: 对于短命工具来说，这种开销可以与程序执行的有用工作相媲美，并且它会在启动许多进程的 shell 提示、脚本、构建和服务中复合。

sentences.en: If it works at Nixpkgs scale, the benefit would reach the whole package set rather than devenv alone, with the largest gains on cold or slow storage, network filesystems, and low-power systems.
sentences.zh: 如果它在 Nixpkgs 规模上工作，那么好处将惠及整个软件包集，而不仅仅是 devenv，其中冷存储或慢速存储、网络文件系统和低功耗系统的收益最大。

blocks.html_en: That reach is also what makes the patch risky: a loader regression could affect almost everything. I spent a full week at Tacosprint comparing five approaches and getting the change working end to end. That effort did not make the patch merge-ready or lower the review bar.

sentences.en: That reach is also what makes the patch risky: a loader regression could affect almost everything.
sentences.zh: 这种影响范围也使得补丁存在风险：加载程序回归可能会影响几乎所有事情。

sentences.en: I spent a full week at Tacosprint comparing five approaches and getting the change working end to end.
sentences.zh: 我在 Tacosprint 花了整整一周的时间比较五种方法，并让变革端到端地发挥作用。

sentences.en: That effort did not make the patch merge-ready or lower the review bar.
sentences.zh: 这项努力并没有使补丁合并做好准备，也没有降低审查标准。

blocks.html_en: One blocking review was explicitly preemptive. On June 26, the reviewer said they would need to reserve “a bunch of hours” to examine the change and that this would not happen for “the next few weeks,” while using “Request Changes” to prevent an “overexcited committer” from merging it. I asked on July 12 when the review might happen and again on July 25 after a month had passed. As of this writing, no detailed review or deadline had followed, and the block remained. Nixpkgs permits an abandoned review to be dismissed, but does not say when a promised future review becomes abandoned.

sentences.en: One blocking review was explicitly preemptive.
sentences.zh: 一项阻止审查显然是先发制人的。

sentences.en: On June 26, the reviewer said they would need to reserve “a bunch of hours” to examine the change and that this would not happen for “the next few weeks,” while using “Request Changes” to prevent an “overexcited committer” from merging it.
sentences.zh: 6 月 26 日，审核者表示，他们需要预留“几个小时”来检查更改，并且“接下来的几周”内不会发生这种情况，同时使用“请求更改”来防止“过度兴奋的提交者”合并它。

sentences.en: I asked on July 12 when the review might happen and again on July 25 after a month had passed.
sentences.zh: 我在7月12日询问过什么时候可以进行审核，并在一个月后的7月25日再次询问。

sentences.en: As of this writing, no detailed review or deadline had followed, and the block remained.
sentences.zh: 截至撰写本文时，尚未进行详细审查或截止日期，该区块仍然存在。

sentences.en: Nixpkgs permits an abandoned review to be dismissed, but does not say when a promised future review becomes abandoned.
sentences.zh: Nixpkgs 允许驳回已放弃的审查，但没有说明承诺的未来审查何时被放弃。

blocks.html_en: The useful reviews were demanding. They found bounds-checking and 32-bit overflow problems, questioned the cache format, asked about future loaders, and challenged whether a downstream glibc patch should be enabled before going upstream. The pull request improved because of them. This is what review is for.

sentences.en: The useful reviews were demanding.
sentences.zh: 有用的评论要求很高。

sentences.en: They found bounds-checking and 32-bit overflow problems, questioned the cache format, asked about future loaders, and challenged whether a downstream glibc patch should be enabled before going upstream.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了边界检查和 32 位溢出问题，对缓存格式提出了质疑，询问了未来的加载器，并质疑在上游之前是否应该启用下游 glibc 补丁。

sentences.en: The pull request improved because of them.
sentences.zh: 由于他们，拉取请求得到了改善。

sentences.en: This is what review is for.
sentences.zh: 这就是审查的目的。

blocks.html_en: Those technical concerns could independently justify blocking the patch. But some comments moved from the patch to the author. A blocking review questioned what expertise I had acquired and whether I had a hidden goal. The original author of an earlier implementation called LLMs “plagiarism machinery” and asked that the work not be merged.

sentences.en: Those technical concerns could independently justify blocking the patch.
sentences.zh: 这些技术问题可以独立地证明阻止该补丁是合理的。

sentences.en: But some comments moved from the patch to the author.
sentences.zh: 但有些评论从补丁转移到了作者身上。

sentences.en: A blocking review questioned what expertise I had acquired and whether I had a hidden goal.
sentences.zh: 一项阻碍性审查质疑我获得了哪些专业知识以及我是否有隐藏的目标。

sentences.en: The original author of an earlier implementation called LLMs “plagiarism machinery” and asked that the work not be merged.
sentences.zh: 早期实现的原作者将 LLM 称为“抄袭机器”，并要求不要合并该作品。

blocks.html_en: Attribution was a legitimate concern. I added the original author as a co-author to the Nixpkgs commit and credited the earlier approach elsewhere, but reviewers argued that the patchelf history still lacked durable attribution and that the boundary between the old and new work was unclear. Those are defects that can be fixed.

sentences.en: Attribution was a legitimate concern.
sentences.zh: 归因是一个合理的担忧。

sentences.en: I added the original author as a co-author to the Nixpkgs commit and credited the earlier approach elsewhere, but reviewers argued that the patchelf history still lacked durable attribution and that the boundary between the old and new work was unclear.
sentences.zh: 我将原作者添加为 Nixpkgs 提交的共同作者，并在其他地方归功于早期的方法，但审稿人认为 patchelf 历史仍然缺乏持久的归属，并且新旧作品之间的界限尚不清楚。

sentences.en: Those are defects that can be fixed.
sentences.zh: 这些都是可以修复的缺陷。

blocks.html_en: The work was public, licensed, and abandoned; continuing it did not require the original author’s permission. In hindsight, advance notice might have avoided surprise and made collaboration easier.

sentences.en: The work was public, licensed, and abandoned; continuing it did not require the original author’s permission.
sentences.zh: 该作品是公开的、获得许可的，但后来被放弃了；继续它不需要原作者的许可。

sentences.en: In hindsight, advance notice might have avoided surprise and made collaboration easier.
sentences.zh: 事后看来，提前通知可能可以避免意外并使协作变得更容易。

blocks.html_en: The distinction is simple. “This must go upstream first” is a requirement. “The cache needs a compatibility contract” is a requirement. “Credit the old work in these permanent locations” is a requirement. “Answer these loader questions and identify a maintainer” is a requirement.

sentences.en: The distinction is simple.
sentences.zh: 区别很简单。

sentences.en: “This must go upstream first” is a requirement.
sentences.zh: “这必须先上游”是一个要求。

sentences.en: “The cache needs a compatibility contract” is a requirement.
sentences.zh: “缓存需要兼容性合同”是一个要求。

sentences.en: “Credit the old work in these permanent locations” is a requirement.
sentences.zh: “归功于这些永久地点的旧作品”是一项要求。

sentences.en: “Answer these loader questions and identify a maintainer” is a requirement.
sentences.zh: “回答这些加载器问题并确定维护人员”是一项要求。

blocks.html_en: “We do not know whether the author has expertise” becomes useful only when it points to a specific unanswered question or maintenance risk. “Perhaps he wants something else” is merely a guess about motive.

sentences.en: “We do not know whether the author has expertise” becomes useful only when it points to a specific unanswered question or maintenance risk.
sentences.zh: “我们不知道作者是否有专业知识”只有在指出特定的未解答问题或维护风险时才有用。

sentences.en: “Perhaps he wants something else” is merely a guess about motive.
sentences.zh: “也许他想要别的东西”只是对动机的猜测。

blocks.html_en: These three cases differ in severity. In each, legitimate concerns became entangled with an exercise of authority whose basis, limits, or remedy were unclear.

sentences.en: These three cases differ in severity.
sentences.zh: 这三种情况的严重程度各有不同。

sentences.en: In each, legitimate concerns became entangled with an exercise of authority whose basis, limits, or remedy were unclear.
sentences.zh: 在每一个案件中，合理的关切都与权力的行使纠缠在一起，而权力的基础、限制或补救措施都不清楚。

blocks.html_en: The older problem

sentences.en: The older problem
sentences.zh: 老问题

blocks.html_en: AI made this conflict visible, but did not create it.

sentences.en: AI made this conflict visible, but did not create it.
sentences.zh: 人工智能使这种冲突变得可见，但并没有创造它。

blocks.html_en: Jo Freeman’s 1972 essay The Tyranny of Structurelessness described the same failure in the feminist movement. A group that refuses formal structure does not get rid of power. It hides power in informal elites and unwritten criteria that newcomers cannot see or appeal to. Freeman’s fix was explicit delegation, defined authority, and accountability to the group.

sentences.en: Jo Freeman’s 1972 essay The Tyranny of Structurelessness described the same failure in the feminist movement.
sentences.zh: 乔·弗里曼 1972 年的文章《无结构的暴政》描述了女权运动中的同样失败。

sentences.en: A group that refuses formal structure does not get rid of power.
sentences.zh: 一个拒绝正式结构的团体并不能摆脱权力。

sentences.en: It hides power in informal elites and unwritten criteria that newcomers cannot see or appeal to.
sentences.zh: 它隐藏了非正式精英的权力和新来者无法看到或吸引的不成文标准。

sentences.en: Freeman’s fix was explicit delegation, defined authority, and accountability to the group.
sentences.zh: 弗里曼的解决方案是明确的授权、明确的权力以及对团队的责任。

blocks.html_en: Other open-source projects put explicit constraints around power. The Apache Software Foundation says that a veto without technical justification is invalid. Python’s conduct-enforcement procedure requires conflict checks, a two-thirds vote, a concrete plan, and re-evaluation when the reported person responds. Rust provides independent audits of visible sanctions and requires conflicted auditors to recuse themselves. Debian developers can override delegated decisions, while OpenStack requires notice, discussion, quorum, and a recorded vote for governance motions.

sentences.en: Other open-source projects put explicit constraints around power.
sentences.zh: 其他开源项目对权力施加了明确的限制。

sentences.en: The Apache Software Foundation says that a veto without technical justification is invalid.
sentences.zh: Apache 软件基金会表示，没有技术理由的否决是无效的。

sentences.en: Python’s conduct-enforcement procedure requires conflict checks, a two-thirds vote, a concrete plan, and re-evaluation when the reported person responds.
sentences.zh: Python 的行为执行程序需要冲突检查、三分之二投票、具体计划，并在被举报人做出回应时重新评估。

sentences.en: Rust provides independent audits of visible sanctions and requires conflicted auditors to recuse themselves.
sentences.zh: Rust 提供对可见制裁的独立审计，并要求有冲突的审计员回避。

sentences.en: Debian developers can override delegated decisions, while OpenStack requires notice, discussion, quorum, and a recorded vote for governance motions.
sentences.zh: Debian 开发人员可以推翻委托决策，而 OpenStack 需要通知、讨论、法定人数和治理动议的记录投票。

blocks.html_en: The mechanisms differ. Their purpose is the same: make authority legible and make mistakes correctable.

sentences.en: The mechanisms differ.
sentences.zh: 机制不同。

sentences.en: Their purpose is the same: make authority legible and make mistakes correctable.
sentences.zh: 他们的目的是相同的：让权威清晰可见，让错误可以纠正。

blocks.html_en: Pieter Hintjens’s Collective Code Construction Contract goes further. It defines a correct patch through written requirements, tells maintainers not to make value judgments about one, and asks anyone who prefers another correct solution to submit that solution as a competing patch. Hintjens called review delay “change latency.” He warned that delaying and blocking patches gives maintainers power over contributors, even when the abuse is subconscious, and argued that a project whose maintainers cannot respond rapidly needs more hands.

sentences.en: Pieter Hintjens’s Collective Code Construction Contract goes further.
sentences.zh: Pieter Hintjens 的《集体代码构建合同》更进一步。

sentences.en: It defines a correct patch through written requirements, tells maintainers not to make value judgments about one, and asks anyone who prefers another correct solution to submit that solution as a competing patch.
sentences.zh: 它通过书面需求定义了正确的补丁，告诉维护人员不要对补丁做出价值判断，并要求任何喜欢另一个正确解决方案的人将该解决方案作为竞争补丁提交。

sentences.en: Hintjens called review delay “change latency.”
sentences.zh: Hintjens 将审核延迟称为“更改延迟”。

sentences.en: He warned that delaying and blocking patches gives maintainers power over contributors, even when the abuse is subconscious, and argued that a project whose maintainers cannot respond rapidly needs more hands.
sentences.zh: 他警告说，延迟和阻止补丁使维护者拥有凌驾于贡献者之上的权力，即使这种滥用是潜意识的，并认为维护者无法快速响应的项目​​需要更多的人手。

blocks.html_en: Nixpkgs should not optimistically merge a world-rebuilding glibc patch. But it can adopt the underlying rule: a concrete risk may block; an unavailable reviewer or an undocumented preference may not. Risky experiments need an isolated test path, not an indefinite veto.

sentences.en: Nixpkgs should not optimistically merge a world-rebuilding glibc patch.
sentences.zh: Nixpkgs 不应乐观地合并重建世界的 glibc 补丁。

sentences.en: But it can adopt the underlying rule: a concrete risk may block; an unavailable reviewer or an undocumented preference may not.
sentences.zh: 但它可以采用基本规则：具体的风险可能会阻止；无法进行审阅或未记录的偏好可能不会。

sentences.en: Risky experiments need an isolated test path, not an indefinite veto.
sentences.zh: 有风险的实验需要一个孤立的测试路径，而不是无限期的否决权。

blocks.html_en: Review friction has a real cost, though the evidence should not be overstated. I am not aware of a controlled study showing that nitpicking is the main reason people leave Nixpkgs. There are, however, repeated reports of contributors losing interest when requirements are undocumented or inconsistent.

sentences.en: Review friction has a real cost, though the evidence should not be overstated.
sentences.zh: 审查摩擦确实会带来成本，但证据不应被夸大。

sentences.en: I am not aware of a controlled study showing that nitpicking is the main reason people leave Nixpkgs.
sentences.zh: 我不知道有哪项对照研究表明吹毛求疵是人们离开 Nixpkgs 的主要原因。

sentences.en: There are, however, repeated reports of contributors losing interest when requirements are undocumented or inconsistent.
sentences.zh: 然而，不断有报告称，当需求没有记录或不一致时，贡献者就会失去兴趣。

blocks.html_en: A 2021 contributor said conflicting formatter requests made them want to close their pull requests and spend their time elsewhere. A 2023 thread collected similar reports about obstacles to contribution. The 2022 community survey found that some respondents avoided opening pull requests because the backlog made timely review seem unlikely. In the 2025 survey, 7.0% reported slow feedback, 5.8% got stuck after starting, and 2.1% found feedback unhelpful or unclear. These categories overlap, and the survey does not attribute them specifically to nitpicking.

sentences.en: A 2021 contributor said conflicting formatter requests made them want to close their pull requests and spend their time elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 2021 年的贡献者表示，相互冲突的格式化程序请求让他们想要关闭拉取请求并将时间花在其他地方。

sentences.en: A 2023 thread collected similar reports about obstacles to contribution.
sentences.zh: 2023 年的一个帖子收集了有关贡献障碍的类似报告。

sentences.en: The 2022 community survey found that some respondents avoided opening pull requests because the backlog made timely review seem unlikely.
sentences.zh: 2022 年社区调查发现，一些受访者避免打开拉取请求，因为积压的工作使得及时审查似乎不太可能。

sentences.en: In the 2025 survey, 7.0% reported slow feedback, 5.8% got stuck after starting, and 2.1% found feedback unhelpful or unclear.
sentences.zh: 在 2025 年的调查中，7.0% 的人表示反馈缓慢，5.8% 的人在开始后陷入困境，2.1% 的人认为反馈没有帮助或不清楚。

sentences.en: These categories overlap, and the survey does not attribute them specifically to nitpicking.
sentences.zh: 这些类别是重叠的，调查并没有将它们具体归咎于吹毛求疵。

blocks.html_en: Strict review is not itself a problem. The problem is a preference presented as a requirement without a rule, a concrete risk, or a stable condition for acceptance. If a mechanical rule matters enough to block a contribution, write it down and automate it. If it is merely a preference, call it a suggestion.

sentences.en: Strict review is not itself a problem.
sentences.zh: 严格审查本身并不是问题。

sentences.en: The problem is a preference presented as a requirement without a rule, a concrete risk, or a stable condition for acceptance.
sentences.zh: 问题是作为要求提出的偏好，没有规则、具体风险或稳定的接受条件。

sentences.en: If a mechanical rule matters enough to block a contribution, write it down and automate it.
sentences.zh: 如果一条机械规则重要到足以阻止贡献，请将其写下来并使其自动化。

sentences.en: If it is merely a preference, call it a suggestion.
sentences.zh: 如果这只是一个偏好，那就称之为建议。

blocks.html_en: What should change

sentences.en: What should change
sentences.zh: 应该改变什么

blocks.html_en: Nixpkgs does not need ideological agreement. It needs rules strong enough for people who disagree to keep working together.

sentences.en: Nixpkgs does not need ideological agreement.
sentences.zh: Nixpkgs 不需要意识形态上的一致。

sentences.en: It needs rules strong enough for people who disagree to keep working together.
sentences.zh: 它需要足够强大的规则，让不同意见的人能够继续合作。

blocks.html_en: First, separate emergency suspension from indefinite removal. An indefinite removal should require written allegations against published standards, notice, time to respond, conflict checks, and agreement by a panel of at least three disinterested people. It should end with a reasoned summary and an appeal to an independent body. The newer guidelines are a good start; they should replace the formal one-person rule.

sentences.en: First, separate emergency suspension from indefinite removal.
sentences.zh: 首先，将紧急停职与无限期撤职分开。

sentences.en: An indefinite removal should require written allegations against published standards, notice, time to respond, conflict checks, and agreement by a panel of at least three disinterested people.
sentences.zh: 无限期删除应要求针对已公布的标准提出书面指控、通知、回应时间、冲突检查以及至少由三名无利害关系人士组成的小组的同意。

sentences.en: It should end with a reasoned summary and an appeal to an independent body.
sentences.zh: 它应该以合理的总结和向独立机构的上诉结束。

sentences.en: The newer guidelines are a good start; they should replace the formal one-person rule.
sentences.zh: 新的指导方针是一个良好的开端；他们应该取代正式的一人规则。

blocks.html_en: Second, make blocking reviews actionable. Nixpkgs already says that comments are non-blocking by default, that blocks must use “Request Changes,” and that abandoned reviews may be dismissed. A block should also identify a documented requirement, policy violation, or technical risk, and say how it can be resolved.

sentences.en: Second, make blocking reviews actionable.
sentences.zh: 其次，使屏蔽审查具有可操作性。

sentences.en: Nixpkgs already says that comments are non-blocking by default, that blocks must use “Request Changes,” and that abandoned reviews may be dismissed.
sentences.zh: Nixpkgs 已经表示默认情况下评论是非阻塞的，阻塞必须使用“请求更改”，并且可能会驳回放弃的评论。

sentences.en: A block should also identify a documented requirement, policy violation, or technical risk, and say how it can be resolved.
sentences.zh: 块还应该识别记录的要求、政策违规或技术风险，并说明如何解决。

blocks.html_en: Review feedback then falls into three categories. A required change names a defect and a stable acceptance condition. A suggestion offers a preferred alternative to an otherwise acceptable patch. A follow-up expands the scope and belongs in a separate issue. Only the first should block.

sentences.en: Review feedback then falls into three categories.
sentences.zh: 审核反馈分为三类。

sentences.en: A required change names a defect and a stable acceptance condition.
sentences.zh: 所需的更改命名了缺陷和稳定的验收条件。

sentences.en: A suggestion offers a preferred alternative to an otherwise acceptable patch.
sentences.zh: 建议为其他可接受的补丁提供了首选替代方案。

sentences.en: A follow-up expands the scope and belongs in a separate issue.
sentences.zh: 后续内容扩大了范围，属于一个单独的问题。

sentences.en: Only the first should block.
sentences.zh: 只有第一个应该阻止。

blocks.html_en: Third, define how project-wide policy is decided. Name the decision-maker, who may participate, the discussion period, the threshold, whether polls are advisory, where reasons and dissent are recorded, and when the decision may be revisited. GitHub reactions are feedback, not a constitution.

sentences.en: Third, define how project-wide policy is decided.
sentences.zh: 第三，定义如何决定项目范围的政策。

sentences.en: Name the decision-maker, who may participate, the discussion period, the threshold, whether polls are advisory, where reasons and dissent are recorded, and when the decision may be revisited.
sentences.zh: 指定可以参与的决策者、讨论期限、门槛、民意调查是否具有咨询性、记录理由和异议的位置以及何时可以重新审视决策。

sentences.en: GitHub reactions are feedback, not a constitution.
sentences.zh: GitHub 的反应是反馈，而不是宪法。

blocks.html_en: Fourth, apply the automation policy Nixpkgs actually adopted. Hold the human responsible, require disclosure, and reject unreviewed or poor work. Then judge compliant contributions against the stated technical rules. If Nixpkgs wants to ban LLM assistance, it should change the policy explicitly.

sentences.en: Fourth, apply the automation policy Nixpkgs actually adopted.
sentences.zh: 第四，应用 Nixpkgs 实际采用的自动化策略。

sentences.en: Hold the human responsible, require disclosure, and reject unreviewed or poor work.
sentences.zh: 追究人员责任，要求披露，并拒绝未经审查或糟糕的工作。

sentences.en: Then judge compliant contributions against the stated technical rules.

content_html_zh:
Nixpkgs 存在正当程序问题。

当人们拥有实权但周围的规则模糊时，项目就会出现正当程序问题。 Nixpkgs 提交者可以合并和关闭拉取请求。 审稿人可以阻止它们。 团队可以删除提交访问权限并决定策略。 然而，该项目并不总是说明适用什么标准、由谁决定或如何纠正错误。

这并不是反对严格审查的理由。 安全性、许可、归属、维护者时间和贡献者行为都很重要。 我最近提交的glibc工作改变了动态加载器并重建了世界。 应异常仔细地对其进行审查。 我也做过糟糕的合并。

对治理的考验不是它是否给了我我想要的东西。 问题是如果人和职位对调我是否会接受同样的规则。

丢失提交位

我为 Nix 和 NixOS 做出了十多年的贡献，担任发布经理，并帮助 Nixpkgs 向数百名贡献者授予了提交访问权限。 2025 年 6 月 8 日，提交位代表团以“一贯的错误判断模式”为由删除了我的访问权限。 它给出了两个原因：我在打开拉取请求后不久就合并了它们，并且我合并了无法在每个平台上构建的 rbtools 更新。

这两种担忧都是真实的。 该包在运行时已经损坏，我试图恢复旧的叶包，但我应该检查更新是否已构建。 其他贡献者后来修复了其缺失的依赖项。

我也不应该这么快合并我的拉取请求。 一条警告线程识别出三个较早的快速自合并和一个 37 秒的自合并恢复。 我解释了引发警告的更改的紧迫性，然后按照要求的工作流程进行操作。 另一位贡献者指出，这是我第一次正式警告，我没有再次自我合并。

问题不在于我是否犯了错误。 这就是这些错误导致无限期失去访问权限、且没有明确的审查或恢复流程的原因。

一个月前，该组织改变了流程。 5 月 11 日，它向代表团添加了对我的合并做法提出质疑的人。 5 月 14 日，它用允许一名委托者删除提交者的规则取代了对提交者列表变更的一致同意。 不到一个月后，新的代表宣布我的免职。

这一序列并不能证明该规则是针对我的，或者是一个人做出的决定。 公告称，团队对此进行了讨论。 公开记录确实表明，单人驱逐是正式可能的，没有公布警告阈值，代表团也没有先联系我。 没有任何书面上诉。

此后，该流程得到了改进。 2025年12月，Nixpkgs核心团队接管了该代表团，并发布了指导方针，表示将尽力讨论担忧、发出警告、达成共识，并确定非一致罢免的参与者。

但这些是团队渴望遵循的指导方针。 正式规则仍然规定一名成员可以删除一名提交者。 没有超过一名成员的约束性门槛，没有回避规则，没有回应期，也没有上诉。

我多次要求 NixOS 指导委员会审查我的删除行为，但没有收到回复。 2025 年 9 月 10 日，在一封题为“你的提交位”的电子邮件中，宣布该消息的人道歉，并表示他们认为这是一个错误，我的访问权限应该恢复。 读者无法独立验证这种私人交换。 我将其列入是因为它暴露了实际差距：即使代表团成员后来认为删除是错误的，也没有明确的审查或恢复过程。 截至撰写本文时，我仍然没有 Nixpkgs 提交访问权限。

安全敏感的项目必须能够快速暂停访问。 但紧急暂停和无限期移除是不同的操作。 第二个应该要求书面指控、通知、回应机会、冲突回避、几个无利害关系人的同意、理由和上诉。

谁决定的？

尼克斯不是直接民主国家。 它有一个选举产生的指导委员会，负责技术和社区领导，并确保存在明确的决策和升级流程。 该委员会已将 Nixpkgs 的治理委托给 Nixpkgs 核心团队，其任务包括建立自下而上的共识并解决分歧。 指导委员会的任务规定，当被授权的团队未能达成决定时，授权并不会终止其责任。

相关政策已经经过了这个结构。 经过核心团队内部以及与社区团队的讨论，核心团队提出了自动化和人工智能政策，开放征求公众反馈，并于 2026 年 5 月合并。 该政策并不禁止 LLM 援助。 它需要一个负责任的人来审查工作并披露不平凡的自动化。

Nixpkgs PR #534657 添加了一行告诉编码代理遵循该策略，以及 CLAUDE.md 符号链接。 它没有提议改变政策本身。 如果没有该指针，使用编码代理的人们可以在工具看到 CONTRIBUTING.md 的情况下提交更改，从而产生可避免的违反披露和人工审核规则的行为。 然后，审阅者继承了两行存储库更改可能会阻止的清理工作。

拉取请求披露了其帮助，并且一些贡献者批准了它。 然后一位审稿人利用 GitHub 的阻塞“请求更改”机制说道：

唯一合理的 AGENTS.md 文件是：滚出这里。

这没有指出任何缺陷，没有引用任何规则，也没有提供任何接受的途径。 它还没有达到 Nixpkgs 的审查指南，该指南要求审查人员关注变更，缩小范围，解释为什么相关工作必须阻止它，并得出结论。

有充分的理由质疑拉取请求。 它的清单夸大了已经测试过的内容。 CLAUDE.md 对一位供应商给予了特权。 代理文件可能表明项目需要更多自动化贡献。 审阅者可以合理地要求提供供应商中立的措辞或证明该文件改进了策略合规性的证据。

相反，该帖子的大部分内容变成了关于版权、能源、水、资本主义、就业、创造力以及 LLM 用户是否属于自由软件的争论。 让工具读取规则的机制变成了对工具本身的投票。

经过内部讨论和测试后，核心团队表示，指向该政策的最小代理文件可能会给社区带来好处。 一位核心团队成员随后澄清，这只是一个意见，而不是最终决定，持续的僵局最终将由核心团队负责解决。

九天后，一名提交者以“被社区拒绝”为由关闭了拉取请求。 最后的评论依赖于评论、反应和非正式的 Discourse 民意调查。 它称该贡献“草率”和“氛围检查”，并认为“某种多数决定”足以拒绝它。 它向核心团队提出了上诉，但没有公布的规则定义了多数、何时适用上诉或核心团队将使用什么标准。 同一条评论敦促任何考虑上诉的人首先询问这是否“真的符合社区的最大利益”。 被审查决定的人劝阻的上诉并不是什么补救措施。 我没有上诉。 我在拉取请求中回复说，关闭与 Nixpkgs 所采用的自动化政策相冲突，并且该线程无法代表社区发言。

Nixpkgs 的目标是自下而上达成共识，但共识并不是对出现在评论线程中的人进行计数。 反应和自愿民意调查可以为决定提供依据。 该民意调查询问人们对 LLM 使用的总体感受，而不是 Nixpkgs 是否应该帮助已经使用 LLM 的贡献者在遵循其政策的同时高效工作。 对第一个问题的中立并不意味着反对第二个问题。 如果没有明确的选民、范围、法定人数、阈值或将决定分配给投票的规则，民意调查也不能代表“社区”。 这条线索产生了没有民主程序的直接民主的表象。

也许拉取请求应该被拒绝。 问题不在于其作者不同意。 问题在于，没有任何已发布的规则授权提交者将非正式反馈转化为“社区”的决定。 GitHub 权限回答了谁可以关闭拉取请求。 他们没有回答谁决定了政策问题。

当评论变得个性化时

Nixpkgs PR #535735 是相反的变化。 它修补 glibc、更新 patchelf、触及引导路径并导致大规模重建。 任何人都不能随意合并。

这一更改解决了 Nixpkgs 中几乎每个动态链接的 Linux 程序所产生的启动开销。 对于短命工具来说，这种开销可以与程序执行的有用工作相媲美，并且它会在启动许多进程的 shell 提示、脚本、构建和服务中复合。 如果它在 Nixpkgs 规模上工作，那么好处将惠及整个软件包集，而不仅仅是 devenv，其中冷存储或慢速存储、网络文件系统和低功耗系统的收益最大。

这种影响范围也使得补丁存在风险：加载程序回归可能会影响几乎所有事情。 我在 Tacosprint 花了整整一周的时间比较五种方法，并让变革端到端地发挥作用。 这项努力并没有使补丁合并做好准备，也没有降低审查标准。

一项阻止审查显然是先发制人的。 6 月 26 日，审核者表示，他们需要预留“几个小时”来检查更改，并且“接下来的几周”内不会发生这种情况，同时使用“请求更改”来防止“过度兴奋的提交者”合并它。 我在7月12日询问过什么时候可以进行审核，并在一个月后的7月25日再次询问。 截至撰写本文时，尚未进行详细审查或截止日期，该区块仍然存在。 Nixpkgs 允许驳回已放弃的审查，但没有说明承诺的未来审查何时被放弃。

有用的评论要求很高。 他们发现了边界检查和 32 位溢出问题，对缓存格式提出了质疑，询问了未来的加载器，并质疑在上游之前是否应该启用下游 glibc 补丁。 由于他们，拉取请求得到了改善。 这就是审查的目的。

这些技术问题可以独立地证明阻止该补丁是合理的。 但有些评论从补丁转移到了作者身上。 一项阻碍性审查质疑我获得了哪些专业知识以及我是否有隐藏的目标。 早期实现的原作者将 LLM 称为“抄袭机器”，并要求不要合并该作品。

归因是一个合理的担忧。 我将原作者添加为 Nixpkgs 提交的共同作者，并在其他地方归功于早期的方法，但审稿人认为 patchelf 历史仍然缺乏持久的归属，并且新旧作品之间的界限尚不清楚。 这些都是可以修复的缺陷。

该作品是公开的、获得许可的，但后来被放弃了；继续它不需要原作者的许可。 事后看来，提前通知可能可以避免意外并使协作变得更容易。

区别很简单。 “这必须先上游”是一个要求。 “缓存需要兼容性合同”是一个要求。 “归功于这些永久地点的旧作品”是一项要求。 “回答这些加载器问题并确定维护人员”是一项要求。

“我们不知道作者是否有专业知识”只有在指出特定的未解答问题或维护风险时才有用。 “也许他想要别的东西”只是对动机的猜测。

这三种情况的严重程度各有不同。 在每一个案件中，合理的关切都与权力的行使纠缠在一起，而权力的基础、限制或补救措施都不清楚。

老问题

人工智能使这种冲突变得可见，但并没有创造它。

乔·弗里曼 1972 年的文章《无结构的暴政》描述了女权运动中的同样失败。 一个拒绝正式结构的团体并不能摆脱权力。 它隐藏了非正式精英的权力和新来者无法看到或吸引的不成文标准。 弗里曼的解决方案是明确的授权、明确的权力以及对团队的责任。

其他开源项目对权力施加了明确的限制。 Apache 软件基金会表示，没有技术理由的否决是无效的。 Python 的行为执行程序需要冲突检查、三分之二投票、具体计划，并在被举报人做出回应时重新评估。 Rust 提供对可见制裁的独立审计，并要求有冲突的审计员回避。 Debian 开发人员可以推翻委托决策，而 OpenStack 需要通知、讨论、法定人数和治理动议的记录投票。

机制不同。 他们的目的是相同的：让权威清晰可见，让错误可以纠正。

Pieter Hintjens 的《集体代码构建合同》更进一步。 它通过书面需求定义了正确的补丁，告诉维护人员不要对补丁做出价值判断，并要求任何喜欢另一个正确解决方案的人将该解决方案作为竞争补丁提交。 Hintjens 将审核延迟称为“更改延迟”。 他警告说，延迟和阻止补丁使维护者拥有凌驾于贡献者之上的权力，即使这种滥用是潜意识的，并认为维护者无法快速响应的项目​​需要更多的人手。

Nixpkgs 不应乐观地合并重建世界的 glibc 补丁。 但它可以采用基本规则：具体的风险可能会阻止；无法进行审阅或未记录的偏好可能不会。 有风险的实验需要一个孤立的测试路径，而不是无限期的否决权。

审查摩擦确实会带来成本，但证据不应被夸大。 我不知道有哪项对照研究表明吹毛求疵是人们离开 Nixpkgs 的主要原因。 然而，不断有报告称，当需求没有记录或不一致时，贡献者就会失去兴趣。

2021 年的贡献者表示，相互冲突的格式化程序请求让他们想要关闭拉取请求并将时间花在其他地方。 2023 年的一个帖子收集了有关贡献障碍的类似报告。 2022 年社区调查发现，一些受访者避免打开拉取请求，因为积压的工作使得及时审查似乎不太可能。 在 2025 年的调查中，7.0% 的人表示反馈缓慢，5.8% 的人在开始后陷入困境，2.1% 的人认为反馈没有帮助或不清楚。 这些类别是重叠的，调查并没有将它们具体归咎于吹毛求疵。

严格审查本身并不是问题。 问题是作为要求提出的偏好，没有规则、具体风险或稳定的接受条件。 如果一条机械规则重要到足以阻止贡献，请将其写下来并使其自动化。 如果这只是一个偏好，那就称之为建议。

应该改变什么

Nixpkgs 不需要意识形态上的一致。 它需要足够强大的规则，让不同意见的人能够继续合作。

首先，将紧急停职与无限期撤职分开。 无限期删除应要求针对已公布的标准提出书面指控、通知、回应时间、冲突检查以及至少由三名无利害关系人士组成的小组的同意。 它应该以合理的总结和向独立机构的上诉结束。 新的指导方针是一个良好的开端；他们应该取代正式的一人规则。

其次，使屏蔽审查具有可操作性。 Nixpkgs 已经表示默认情况下评论是非阻塞的，阻塞必须使用“请求更改”，并且可能会驳回放弃的评论。 块还应该识别记录的要求、政策违规或技术风险，并说明如何解决。

审核反馈分为三类。 所需的更改命名了缺陷和稳定的验收条件。 建议为其他可接受的补丁提供了首选替代方案。 后续内容扩大了范围，属于一个单独的问题。 只有第一个应该阻止。

第三，定义如何决定项目范围的政策。 指定可以参与的决策者、讨论期限、门槛、民意调查是否具有咨询性、记录理由和异议的位置以及何时可以重新审视决策。 GitHub 的反应是反馈，而不是宪法。

第四，应用 Nixpkgs 实际采用的自动化策略。 追究人员责任，要求披露，并拒绝未经审查或糟糕的工作。 然后根据规定的技术规则判断合规的贡献。 如果 Nixpkgs 想要禁止 LLM 援助，就应该明确改变政策。

第五，尽可能测试声明。 供应商中立的 AGENTS.md 提案可以包括前后测试：它是否改善了披露、清单准确性、测试执行和政策合规性？ 可以使用有关恢复、CI 失败、审核时间、违规和维护人员负担的数据来审核策略本身。

最后，自动化机械需求。 格式、元数据和平台检查应该是可重复的命令或分支保护，而不是不同审阅者头脑中携带的不同规则。

这些改革应该是单独的决定。 我对恢复访问的请求不应决定一般的删除过程。 两行代理文件不应决定整个自动化策略。 有风险的 glibc 补丁不应决定 LLM 辅助的贡献者是否属于其中。

同样的规则应该在未来支持人工智能的多数派中保护反人工智能的贡献者。 否则，正当程序只是请求用另一派系的自由裁量权取代另一派系的自由裁量权。

写下明确的规则。 需要可行的审查。 发出通知、理由、回避和上诉。 法官根据现行政策工作，直到通过合法程序改变该政策为止。

正当程序需要明确的删除、审查阻止和政策决定规则。 它还需要一种纠正错误的方法。
